observations: Blue and black high-pressure water machine.
Power cord is coiled around the body.
Water outlet nozzle is visible at the top.
The machine is resting on a light-colored wooden surface.
A watermark 'DANCOLE FURNITURE TEXTURES' is visible across the center.

claims.claim: pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance
claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine running and the nozzle spraying water.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal leaks.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the nozzle producing a strong stream of water.

risks.risk: The pressure rating (e.g., 150bar, 200bar) is unknown, which determines the value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's rating plate, usually on the back or side of the unit.

risks.risk: The motor or pump may be damaged or worn.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through its pressure cycle.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full motor replacement

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the rating plate showing the model number and pressure rating.
Video of the machine plugged in and spraying water.
Photo of the rear of the machine to check for the power plug and any damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
